WMatrix¶

class stoch_imp.WMatrix.WMatrix(*args, ds: Symbol | None = None, eq: float = 0, **kwargs)[source]¶

Class handling driven transition matrices.

This class extends TrMatrix to support driven systems where a symbolic parameter (driving symbol) modifies transition rates. It provides methods for calculating equilibrium matrices under driving, extracting first-order derivatives, computing conductivity coefficients, and evaluating frequency-dependent conductivities.

Variables:

  • ds – Symbol representing the driving parameter.

  • eq – Value at which to evaluate equilibrium (default is 0).

  • weq – Cached equilibrium matrix (EqMatrix), or None if not yet computed.

  • w1 – First-order derivative matrix (ConstantMatrix), or None if not yet computed.

  • coeff – Coefficient array for conductivity calculations, or None if not yet computed.
